Configuration.item: SELECT * FROM sys_fuc_users where logname =? and pwd=? and rowstate = '1'

SELECT u.id,u.logname,u.username,u.pwd,u.phone,u.email,r.val AS role,u.bem,u.rowstate,u.sex, u.homeAddress,u.createtime FROM sys_fuc_users u INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.vkey = u.role WHERE u.rowstate = '1' AND (u.logname LIKE '%{1}%' OR u.username LIKE '%{1}%' OR u.phone LIKE '%{1}%' OR u.email LIKE '%{1}%' OR r.val LIKE '%{1}%' OR u.bem LIKE '%{1}%' OR u.sex LIKE '%{1}%' OR u.homeAddress LIKE '%{1}%') ORDER BY u.createtime desc

SELECT * FROM sys_fuc_users WHERE rowstate = '2' AND (logname LIKE '%{1}%' OR username LIKE '%{1}%' OR phone LIKE '%{1}%' OR email LIKE '%{1}%' OR bem LIKE '%{1}%' OR sex LIKE '%{1}%' OR homeAddress LIKE '%{1}%') ORDER BY createtime desc
update sys_fuc_users set rowstate = '2' WHERE id = ?
SELECT * FROM sys_role WHERE 1=1 and (val like '%{1}%' or vkey like '%{1}%' or bem like '%{1}%') ORDER BY createtime desc
SELECT * FROM cdinfo WHERE fnid='0' and (cname like '%{1}%' or cpath like '%{1}%') order by indx
